name: Ribeira
summary: Official Prefeitura do Rio municipal parcel service was found. Layer metadata and anonymous bounded geometry query were verified; exact WUP point was a zero-hit, while a nearby envelope returned three safe polygon features. No unsafe attributes were requested or retained.

queryOutcomes.query: Ribeira Brazil official cadastral map parcel GIS Rio de Janeiro prefeitura
queryOutcomes.outcome: Found the official Prefeitura do Rio CadParcel IMOVEIS_TERRITORIAIS ArcGIS service and official Carioca Digital references to municipal cadastral/parcel map services.

queryOutcomes.query: Ribeira Brasil cadastro imobiliário mapa oficial parcela geoserver prefeitura Rio de Janeiro
queryOutcomes.outcome: Found official Portuguese Prefeitura do Rio/Carioca Digital references for Planta Cadastral, GeoPAL and urban map consultation, plus the official municipal parcel feature service.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Layer metadata returned geometryType esriGeometryPolygon, native spatial reference EPSG:31983 (SIRGAS 2000 / UTM zone 23S), max record count 2000, and fields including objectid plus unsafe cadastral attributes not requested.

Anonymous point query at the exact WUP coordinate transformed to EPSG:31983 returned an empty FeatureCollection with outFields=objectid and returnGeometry=true. This is an exact-point miss only, not evidence of citywide absence.

Anonymous bounded envelope query centered on the transformed WUP point, approximately 2 km by 2 km, with spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects, outFields=objectid, resultRecordCount=3, outSR=4326 returned three polygon features (native objectids 55, 118, 140) and exceededTransferLimit=true. Three full polygons were retained with properties reduced to id only.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [-22.8050293524197,-43.1936610372124] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The exact point returned zero features; this is not evidence of citywide absence. The bounded envelope returned features elsewhere in the vicinity.
Envelope response exceededTransferLimit=true; retained sample is deliberately limited to three polygons and is not a coverage census.

The WUP label Ribeira may denote a locality/neighborhood rather than an administrative municipality; source scope is the Rio de Janeiro municipal service, and locality matching was not independently resolved.
Packet completion is research evidence only and is not source integration/admission.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception used.

nativeFieldMapping.provenance: ArcGIS FeatureServer layer's native objectid; GeoJSON response also exposed the same identity as feature id; sample ids 55, 118, 140.

uncertainty: The official municipal service and bounded parcel geometries are evidenced, but exact WUP point coverage is a miss, envelope results were transfer-limited, locality-versus-municipality alignment for the WUP label Ribeira is unresolved, and citywide coverage plus long-term identity semantics remain unverified.
serialReviewRecommendation: Hold. Recheck official service availability, locality alignment, coverage, CRS/axis handling, and native objectid semantics independently before runtime qualification.
